BEFORE YOU BOOK

Keep the trip
comfortably small.

For a first two-night visit, our suggestion is to choose one base. Changing hotels or adding several day trips can turn a short break into a sequence of transfers.

Start with your arrival and departure times. Then decide which one experience matters most. Leave another half-day unbooked so you can follow the weather or simply stay longer somewhere you enjoy.

City or countryside?

This first collection covers Amsterdam and practical travel planning. The windmill image is Dutch countryside inspiration, not a location included in the city itinerary. Dedicated coastal and rural guides will be added after their details are checked.

Choose your season around your plans

Walking and outdoor tables depend on weather; museum-focused breaks are easier to adapt. Keep a wet-weather option and check daylight, events and opening dates for your actual travel dates, rather than assuming one month is always best.
